_comment: Classifications for cosmic_diff.py findings, keyed by finding id (a trailing * matches a prefix). Classes: DELIBERATE, BROKEN, RESTORED, UNSURE, UPSTREAM-NEW (Cosmic added it after MapleRoot forked, about Aug 2023, so nothing was stripped), NOISE (detector false positive). Fork point: the Cosmic commit whose tree best matches baseline 03d13cb21 is b46912afc (2023-08-15).

script-missing:scripts/npc/2110000.js.why: Rosen, the Magatia warehouse keeper (map 261000000). Every other storage NPC kept its script; with none, NPCTalkHandler logs 'not coded' and returns without enableActions, so clicking Rosen does nothing and leaves the player stuck. Restored from Cosmic (2017 script, pre-fork, so the repack stripped it).
script-missing:scripts/npc/2110000.js.qa: `!warp 261000000` (Magatia), click Rosen: the storage window opens (not a frozen client); store an item, close, click again and take it back.

script-commented:scripts/npc/9030000.js:.why: Fredrick (Store Banker) answered 'Sorry, shops are disabled for now.' with the retrieval code commented out. 1.4.0 sells Hired Merchant permits (cashshop/catalog.tsv 5030000-5030xxx) and HiredMerchantRequest/FredrickHandler are stock Cosmic, so items and mesos from an expired or restart-closed merchant could never be claimed. Restored the Cosmic body; hasMerchant/hasMerchantItems/showFredrick are unchanged in NPCConversationManager.
script-commented:scripts/npc/9030000.js:.qa: `!warp 910000000` (FM entrance), click Fredrick with nothing stored: 'You don't have any items or mesos to be retrieved.' `!item 5030000 1`, open the Hired Merchant in an FM room with one item, click Fredrick: 'You have a Merchant open.' Then get the merchant force-closed (test-server restart, which runs closeAllMerchants) and click Fredrick: the Store Banker window lists the item and mesos; retrieve them, check the inventory, click again: 'nothing to be retrieved'.

manual:src/main/java/client/processor/np.why: Found while restoring Fredrick (the detector does not flag it: the method kept most of its statements). fredrickRetrieveItems had lost Cosmic's merchant.clearItems() after deleting the Fredrick rows, a 2021 anti-dupe guard (pre-fork, so the repack dropped it). FREDRICK_ACTION is registered whether or not the NPC talks, so a still-loaded merchant could hand the same items out again. Restored the four lines.
manual:src/main/java/client/processor/np.qa: Covered by the Fredrick retrieval steps: after retrieving, reopening the merchant/Fredrick must not offer the same item again.

The ship no longer breaks from damage. Owner may want to know; not a silent strip of one piece.

java-commented:src/main/java/net/server/.why: Summon damage is no longer clamped to calcMaxDamage (Cosmic: alert + clamp, 'thanks Darter for reporting unchecked max dmg'). An exploit guard, not a player feature; restoring could clip legit summon hits if MapleRoot's stat scaling outruns the estimate. Owner/security call.

Mana Reflection (F/P, I/L, Bishop) reflects a fixed 20 damage instead of X% of the hit (capped at 1/5 mob max HP); the bounce packet to the map is gone too. Likely a compile workaround for MapleRoot's long mob HP. A proper port needs long-safe math; owner call.
Meso Guard costs no mesos; the line is annotated 'Comment out or remove this line' in the repack.
